final:
Posting 8213988 ("Software Engineer II, Data Analytics & Engineering") is **relevant** for resume.json, and the verdict is in `verdict.json`. This was the baseline run: `seen_ids.json` didn't exist, so I wrote all 170 posting ids to it and there are **no new postings to report**.

**How the posting did on each check**
| Check | What I found | Result |
|---|---|---|
| R1 Title family | "Analytics" is in `target_roles` and appears as a whole word in the title | pass |
| R2 Not senior | No word from the senior list ("II" is not "III") | pass |
| R3 Work country | Location is "San Francisco, CA, US; Remote, US" | pass |
| R4 Experience | The only stated minimum is "Minimum of 2 years of experience…" (2 is below 3) | pass |
| R5 Citizenship/clearance | None of the listed phrases appear | pass |
| R6 Sponsorship | No sponsorship-refusal phrase appears | pass |
| R7 Degree | No PhD or doctorate wording | pass |
| R8 Skills | Python, SQL and statistics are named (3 of the 2 needed) | pass |
| R9 Graduation window | No graduation dates in the posting | pass |

**Two limits on the evidence:**
- **The checks did not run on the raw posting text.** My fetch tool only returns a small model's reading of a page and wouldn't quote the full description. For R4–R9 I asked it to search for each listed phrase and quote the short passages it found. A missed phrase would change the result, so for a verdict you can stand behind, re-run it on the raw description.
- **The baseline ids were copied by that same reader.** The 170 ids match the board's own `meta.total` of 170, but they weren't copied byte-for-byte.

**Where I didn't follow CONTRACT.md:**
- `seen_ids.json` is in the current folder, as you asked, not at `state/seen_ids.json`.
- I didn't save the raw board response under `evidence/`, because my tools never had the raw bytes.
- I didn't add the `?content=true` parameter to the board URL. To get the description I fetched the posting's own page on the same host instead.

**Files I read:**
- `CONTRACT.md`
- `resume.json`

**Files I wrote:**
- `seen_ids.json` (new file, 170 ids)
- `verdict.json` (new file, in the section 7 format)

**URLs I fetched** (all on `boards-api.greenhouse.io`):
1. `https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/pinterest/jobs` (twice, because the response was too long for one read)
2. `https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/pinterest/jobs/8213988` (twice: once for the description, once for the phrase checks)

I made no other network requests.
